definitions.gloss: fruit peel; fruit skin; rind; pericarp
definitions.explanation: The outer covering of a fruit, including the skin and any layers between the skin and the seeds. A botanical and culinary term.

examples.japanese: ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果皮|かひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すりおろす。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{果皮|かひ}ごと⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: You can eat this fruit together with the peel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{柑橘類|かんきつるい}→柑橘類：15619_kankitsurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果皮|かひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The peel of citrus fruits is rich in nutrients.

notes:
Composed of {果|か} (fruit) + {皮|ひ} (skin, peel). A formal term used in botany, food science, and product labeling. In everyday conversation, ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧ alone is more commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {果皮|かひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むく — to peel the fruit skin
- {果皮|かひ}ごと⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ — to eat with the peel
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧{果皮|かひ} — dried fruit peel
